documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: 12-digit unique identification number issued by UIDAI
howToGet: Visit nearest Aadhaar enrollment center
Carry proof of identity and address
Biometric data will be collected
Aadhaar will be sent to your address in 60-90 days

documents.name: Voter ID Card
documents.note: Electoral Photo Identity Card issued by Election Commission
howToGet: Visit National Voters' Service Portal (nvsp.in)
Fill Form 6 for new registration
Submit required documents online or at BLO office
Voter ID will be issued after verification

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.note: Issued by tehsildar or sub-divisional magistrate
howToGet: Visit tehsildar office or apply online via state portal
Submit application with Aadhaar, address proof, and salary slips
Pay nominal fee (usually ₹10-50)
Certificate issued within 7-15 days

documents.name: Ration Card
documents.note: Food security card issued by state civil supplies department
howToGet: Apply online via state food & civil supplies portal
Submit Aadhaar, address proof, and family details
Visit fair price shop for biometric verification
Ration card issued within 30 days

documents.name: Utility Bill (Electricity/Water)
documents.note: Recent bill not older than 3 months showing current address
howToGet: Download from electricity/water board website or app
Or visit nearest electricity/water office
Provide consumer number or registered mobile
Print or get physical copy of latest bill

documents.name: Land Ownership Proof
documents.note: Sale deed, registry, or 7/12 extract showing land ownership
howToGet: Visit sub-registrar office or tehsil office
Request certified copy of sale deed or 7/12 extract
Provide survey number and owner details
Pay nominal fee for certified copies
Documents issued same day or within 2-3 days

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: Mandatory for linking with PM-KISAN account
howToGet: Visit nearest Aadhaar enrollment center
Carry proof of identity and address
Biometric data will be collected
Aadhaar will be sent to your address in 60-90 days

documents.name: Khasra / Khatauni (Land Record)
documents.note: Land record document showing ownership and area
howToGet: Visit tehsil or patwari office
Apply online via state revenue portal (e.g., bhulekh.up.nic.in)
Provide khasra number and village name
Certified copy issued on payment of nominal fee

documents.name: Bank Passbook / Account Details
documents.note: Savings account linked to Aadhaar for direct benefit transfer
howToGet: Open account at nearest bank or post office
Link Aadhaar to bank account at bank branch
Ensure IFSC code is correctly noted from passbook
Account must be active and operational

documents.name: Farmer ID / Kisan Credit Card
documents.note: Helps in faster verification of farmer status
howToGet: Apply at nearest bank that offers Kisan Credit Card
Carry land records, identity proof, and Aadhaar
KCC issued within 15 working days after verification

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: Primary identification document for PMJAY registration
howToGet: Visit nearest Aadhaar enrollment center
Carry proof of identity and address
Biometric data will be collected
Aadhaar will be sent to your address in 60-90 days

documents.name: Ration Card
documents.note: BPL/AAY ration card to verify SECC eligibility
howToGet: Apply online via state food & civil supplies portal
Submit Aadhaar, address proof, and family details
Visit fair price shop for biometric verification
Ration card issued within 30 days

documents.name: Family ID / Parivar Pehchan Patra
documents.note: State-issued family identity document (where applicable)
howToGet: Visit Common Service Centre (CSC) near you
Carry Aadhaar cards of all family members
Fill application form and submit biometrics
ID generated online immediately or within 7 days

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.note: May be needed to verify annual household income
howToGet: Visit tehsildar office or apply online via state portal
Submit application with Aadhaar, address proof, and salary slips
Pay nominal fee (usually ₹10-50)
Certificate issued within 7-15 days

documents.name: Existing Health/Insurance Card (if any)
documents.note: Submit if you already have a state health scheme card
howToGet: Check with previous state health scheme office
Online portals of respective state health department
Common Service Centre (CSC) may assist

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: Mandatory for scholarship DBT linkage
howToGet: Visit nearest Aadhaar enrollment center
Carry proof of identity and address
Biometric data will be collected
Aadhaar will be sent to your address in 60-90 days

documents.name: Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
documents.note: Issued by tehsildar confirming caste category
howToGet: Apply at tehsildar office or state e-district portal
Submit Aadhaar, birth certificate, and parent's caste proof
Pay nominal processing fee
Certificate issued within 15 working days

documents.name: Previous Year Marksheet
documents.note: Marks obtained in the last qualifying examination
howToGet: Collect from your school/college examination office
Request duplicate from State Board if lost
Carry both original and self-attested photocopy

documents.name: Bonafide / Admission Certificate
documents.note: Certificate from current institution confirming enrollment
howToGet: Apply at your college/university administrative office
Usually issued free of charge within 1-3 days
Ensure it mentions course, year, and institution details

documents.name: Fee Receipt
documents.note: Official receipt of tuition/hostel fee paid to institution
howToGet: Collect from college accounts/fees department
Online fee receipts downloadable from college ERP
Ensure fee receipt is on institution letterhead

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.note: Parent/guardian annual income must be below scheme threshold
howToGet: Visit tehsildar office or apply online via state portal
Submit application with Aadhaar, address proof, and salary slips
Pay nominal fee (usually ₹10-50)
Certificate issued within 7-15 days

documents.name: Bank Passbook (Student's Account)
documents.note: Student's own savings account linked to Aadhaar for DBT
howToGet: Open account at nearest bank or post office
Link Aadhaar to bank account at bank branch
Ensure IFSC code is correctly noted
Account must be in the student's own name

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.note: Primary KYC document for loan application
howToGet: Visit nearest Aadhaar enrollment center
Carry proof of identity and address
Biometric data will be collected
Aadhaar will be sent to your address in 60-90 days

documents.name: PAN Card
documents.note: Permanent Account Number for tax and financial verification
howToGet: Apply online at incometax.gov.in or NSDL/UTI portal
Fill Form 49A and upload photo, ID, and address proof
Pay fee of ₹110 (Indian address) or ₹1020 (foreign address)
PAN issued within 15-20 working days

documents.name: Business Existence Proof
documents.note: Trade license, Udyam registration, or GST certificate
howToGet: Register on Udyam portal (udyamregistration.gov.in) using Aadhaar
For trade license, apply at local municipal office
For GST, register at gst.gov.in if annual turnover > ₹20 lakh

documents.name: Business Address Proof
documents.note: Utility bill or lease agreement for business premises
howToGet: Collect latest electricity/water bill for the business address
Or provide rent agreement if premises is rented
Self-attested copies are acceptable in most cases

documents.name: Bank Statement (6 months)
documents.note: Recent 6-month bank statement of business/personal account
howToGet: Request from your bank branch or download from net banking
Statement must be on official bank letterhead with stamp
Ensure it shows regular business-related transactions

documents.name: Income Tax Returns (if available)
documents.note: Last 2 years of ITR for higher loan amounts (Kishore/Tarun)
howToGet: File on incometax.gov.in or through a chartered accountant
Download ITR-V acknowledgment from income tax portal
Carry a printout with original signature
